# Lake Group

> English-language corporate information from Lake Group's official website.

## Canonical website

- https://www.lakeoilgroup.com
- [About Lake Group](https://www.lakeoilgroup.com/about.html)
- [Operations Network](https://www.lakeoilgroup.com/africa-network.html)

## Organization

Lake Group is a diversified business group with operations across energy, manufacturing, logistics, real estate, agro processing and automotive sectors.

## Business verticals

- Energies
- Manufacturing
- Logistics
- Real Estate
- Agro Processing
- Automotive

## Operating companies

- [Lake Oil Ltd.](https://www.lakeoilgroup.com/lake-oil.html) — Lake Oil is Lake Group's flagship energy company, operating retail fuel stations and bulk petroleum distribution services.
- [Lake Gas Limited](https://www.lakeoilgroup.com/lake-gas.html) — Lake Gas Limited supplies retail and bulk LPG for household and commercial use across East and Central Africa, with Tanzania as its central hub.
- [Lake Lubes Ltd](https://www.lakeoilgroup.com/lake-lubes.html) — Lake Lubes Ltd produces automotive, industrial and specialty lubricants and greases from its blending and packaging operation in Tanzania.
- [Lake Aviation](https://www.lakeoilgroup.com/lake-aviation.html) — Lake Aviation provides aviation fuel supply and into-plane fueling services across Tanzania and Uganda as part of Lake Energies.
- [Lake Steel & Allied Products Limited](https://www.lakeoilgroup.com/lake-steel.html) — Lake Steel & Allied Products Limited manufactures and supplies TMT reinforcement steel bars for construction applications.
- [Lake Pipes](https://www.lakeoilgroup.com/lake-pipes.html) — Lake Pipes manufactures and distributes PVC and HDPE pipes, water tanks and fittings from its Visiga plant in Kibaha, Tanzania.
- [Lake Building Solution](https://www.lakeoilgroup.com/lake-buildings.html) — Lake Building Solution manufactures gypsum board and marine board in Kibaha Visiga, Tanzania, as part of Lake Group's Manufacturing sector.
- [Lake Premix](https://www.lakeoilgroup.com/lake-premix-cement.html) — Lake Premix provides ready-mix concrete solutions in Dar es Salaam, with operations extended to Kenya through Gulf Premix.
- [Lake Cylinders Limited](https://www.lakeoilgroup.com/lake-cylinders.html) — Lake Cylinders Limited manufactures LPG cylinders supporting safe and reliable LPG solutions in Tanzania and the wider East African market.
- [Gulf Aggregates](https://www.lakeoilgroup.com/gulf-aggregates.html) — Gulf Aggregates operates a quarry at Lugoba, Tanzania, supplying aggregate for ready-mix operations and the construction industry.
- [Lake Trans Limited](https://www.lakeoilgroup.com/lake-trans.html) — Lake Trans Limited provides petroleum product transportation and logistics services across East Africa as part of Lake Group.
- [African Inland Container Depot (AFICD)](https://www.lakeoilgroup.com/aficd.html) — African Inland Container Depot (AFICD) provides ICD, CFS and empty container depot services supporting cargo handling, storage and inland logistics in Tanzania.
- [African Inland Logistics Ltd. (AILL)](https://www.lakeoilgroup.com/aill.html) — African Inland Logistics Ltd. (AILL) provides logistics support and container freight station services in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania.
- [Cross Country Developer Limited](https://www.lakeoilgroup.com/cross-country.html) — Cross Country Developer Limited develops and manages commercial, retail, hospitality and mixed-use properties in Tanzania as part of Lake Group.
- [Lake Agro Limited](https://www.lakeoilgroup.com/lake-agro.html) — Lake Agro Limited develops integrated agricultural and sugar manufacturing operations in Rufiji, Tanzania, as part of Lake Group.
- [Agrinova Tech Limited](https://www.lakeoilgroup.com/agrinova-tech.html) — Agrinova Tech Limited provides agricultural machinery and practical farming solutions in Tanzania as part of Lake Group's Automotive sector.
- [Assembly Tech Limited](https://www.lakeoilgroup.com/assembly-tech.html) — Assembly Tech Limited manufactures aluminium trailers and fuel transportation solutions for commercial transport requirements across East and Central Africa.
- [NextDrive Motors Limited](https://www.lakeoilgroup.com/nextdrive-motors.html) — NextDrive Motors Limited provides commercial vehicle sales, distribution and support for transportation and logistics requirements.

## Geographic context

Lake Group's corporate operations network includes: Tanzania, Kenya, Zambia, Rwanda, Burundi, DR Congo, Ethiopia, Mozambique, Uganda, United Arab Emirates. Individual company pages describe only their own verified operating context.
